 "description": "Introduces the language, concepts, and processes of interactive experience as a compelling medium to communicate meaning. Examines how variables within the environment can change how we inhabit an experience physically, conceptually, and emotionally and affect or provoke responses. Hands-on experimentation offers students an opportunity to learn using one or more forms of rapid prototyping. Studies historical and contemporary examples of art and design projects designed as exchanges or experiences.
